---
title: "Age"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)

# Load the saved Census tract data
sarasota_age <- read_rds("sarasota_age.rds") |>
  drop_na(estimate)

# Plot the distribution of median age across tracts
sarasota_age |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 3, fill = "#2c7fb8", color = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = median(estimate)),
    color = "#d95f02",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Median Age Across Sarasota County Census Tracts",
    subtitle = "Dashed orange line shows the median tract age (~58 years)",
    x = "Median Age (Years)",
    y = "Number of Census Tracts",
    caption = "Source: 2018–2022 5-Year American Community Survey (tidycensus)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
